questions.question: What does Windows Security Event ID 4657 indicate?
questions.explanation: Event ID 4657 is logged when an existing registry value is modified.
questions.objective: Understand the purpose of Event ID 4657

questions.question: Which Windows log contains Event ID 4657?
questions.explanation: Event ID 4657 is recorded in the Security log.

questions.question: What type of activity triggers Event ID 4657?
questions.explanation: The event is generated when an existing registry value is changed.

questions.question: Why do SOC analysts pay close attention to Event ID 4657?
options: Registry modifications can be used for persistence and security tampering
It only occurs during system startup
questions.explanation: Attackers frequently modify the registry to establish persistence or weaken security controls.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a common impact of registry modifications?
questions.explanation: Registry changes affect software and configuration, not physical hardware.

questions.question: Which sequence best represents a common persistence scenario?
questions.explanation: A process is created (4688), modifies a registry value (4657), and establishes persistence.

questions.question: Which factor primarily determines the severity of an Event ID 4657 alert?
questions.explanation: Severity depends on what registry location was modified and why.

questions.question: Event ID 4657 records the modification of an existing registry value.
questions.explanation: This is the primary purpose of Event ID 4657.

questions.question: Which registry modification would generally require the highest priority investigation?
questions.explanation: Changes affecting Defender may indicate security control tampering.

questions.question: Compared to Event ID 4656, Event ID 4657 specifically records:
questions.explanation: 4656 logs handle requests, while 4657 logs the actual registry value modification.
